achievements.name: Distributed Control Authority
achievements.description: Built a multi-instance realtime control system where operators can take over device control safely — single-writer semantics, sub-second handoff, and zero split-brain incidents.

achievements.name: National-Scale SDR Surveillance
achievements.description: Deployed a nationwide airspace surveillance network decoding ADS-B and UAT from distributed SDR receivers, with edge processing and heartbeat health monitoring.

achievements.name: Legacy Platform Migration
achievements.description: Designed and led a full platform modernization — moving a legacy monolith to GraphQL, PostgreSQL and containerized microservices while leading the engineering team.

achievements.name: IoT Fleet Backend
achievements.description: Built fleet-scale device management on cloud infrastructure — MQTT telemetry pipelines, distributed command locking, and vendor hardware integrations.
